verses.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
verses.yusufAli: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things)
verses.rodwell: THE DESIRE of increasing riches occupieth you
verses.sale: The emulous desire of multiplying riches and children employeth you

verses.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves
verses.rodwell: Till ye come to the grave

verses.t: No! You are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know
verses.yusufAli: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality)
verses.rodwell: Nay! but in the end ye shall know
verses.sale: By no means should ye thus employ your time: Hereafter shall ye know your folly

verses.t: Then no! You are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know
verses.rodwell: Nay! once more,in the end ye shall know your folly
verses.sale: Again, by no means: Hereafter shall ye know your folly

verses.t: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty
verses.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge
verses.yusufAli: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware)
verses.rodwell: Nay! would that ye knew it with knowledge of certainty
verses.sale: By no means: If ye knew the consequence hereof with certainty of knowledge, ye would not act thus

verses.t: You will surely see the Hellfire
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty
verses.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision
verses.yusufAli: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight
verses.rodwell: Then shall ye surely see it with the eye of certainty
verses.sale: Again, ye shall surely see it with the eye of certainty

verses.t: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure
verses.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure
verses.yusufAli: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in)
verses.rodwell: Then shall ye on that day be taken to task concerning pleasures
verses.sale: Then shall ye be examined, on that day, concerning the pleasures with which ye have amused yourselves in this life
